description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.
